events.significance: Devotees fast and visit Devi temples; the Purattasi occurrence falls within the major Navratri festival.

events.name: Navratri Begins
events.basis: Shukla Prathamai in Tamil month Purattasi
events.description: Start of the nine nights of Navratri, honoring Durga, Lakshmi, and Saraswati in turn.
events.significance: Major pan-Indian festival; homes set up golu (doll displays) and observe fasts through the nine nights.

events.name: Maha Ashtami
events.basis: Shukla Ashtami tithi in Tamil month Purattasi, within Navratri
events.description: The eighth night of Navratri, dedicated to Durga's fiercest form.
events.significance: Observed with special pujas and, in some traditions, ritual sacrifice or its symbolic equivalent.

events.name: Saraswati Pooja
events.basis: Shukla Navami tithi in Tamil month Purattasi, within Navratri
events.description: The ninth night of Navratri, when books and instruments are placed before Saraswati for blessing.
events.significance: Ayudha Pooja (tools/vehicles) is also observed the same day in Tamil Nadu.

events.name: Vijayadashami
events.basis: Shukla Dashami tithi in Tamil month Purattasi, the day after Navratri
events.description: Celebrates Durga's victory over the demon Mahishasura, concluding Navratri.
events.significance: Widely celebrated as Dasara/Dussehra; also an auspicious day to begin new learning (Vidyarambham).
